feeds.title: EJIL: Talk! » International Humanitarian Law
feeds.description: Blog posts, News, Announcements, and Insights on Armed Conflict, Global Health, Human Rights, Economic Development, and International Humanitarian Law by the European Journal of International Law(EJIL).

feeds.title: Cambridge International Law Journal » International Humanitarian Law
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on International Humanitarian Law, Armed Conflict, Human Rights, Public International Law, and more. The CILJ is a double-blind peer-reviewed journal with a broad focus on international and EU law. It is run by the postgraduate community of the Cambridge Faculty of Law.

feeds.title: Jindal Forum for International and Economic Laws » Humanitarian Law
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on Public International Law, Human Rights, Space Law, Humanitarian Law, International Criminal Law, etc. JFIEL is an online platform which aims to analyze legal developments and foster discourse in the field of international law and the international economic arena.

feeds.title: ICRC Humanitarian Law and Policy Blog
feeds.description: The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) Humanitarian Law & Policy blog is a unique space for timely analysis and debate on international humanitarian law (IHL) issues and the policies that shape humanitarian action.

feeds.title: Canadian Red Cross Blog » International Humanitarian Law
feeds.description: This section focuses on International Humanitarian Law. Also covers articles on Red Cross training, Health care, Refugees, Global Health, Youth, and Conflicts. The Canadian Red Cross Society is part of the largest humanitarian network in the world. Canadian Red Cross helps people and communities in Canada and around the world in times of need and supports them in strengthening their resilience.
